bio.text: John P. Carr is serving his third term in the Arkansas House, representing District 15, which includes a portion of Benton County; the member page lists his address as Rogers.
The legislature lists his occupation as project manager.

He earned a B.S. in computer engineering from the University of Missouri at Columbia and attended the University of Arkansas Executive MBA program to become a Certified Project Management Professional.
